citations.name: John Glasgow
citations.assertion: Existing 1771 child account; its Colinton adult identification remains separate. The FamilySearch citation X17D-67M was checked directly: John was born 13 October 1771 and christened 19 October 1771 at Barony, parents Alexander Glasgow and Mary Munro. The copied 3 December 1765 date attached to that same citation is wrong; no independent 1765 record was verified in this review. This corrects the source account, not the vital fields or later identity of either modern John profile. Burke names Agnes Monro, not the documented Mary Munro of Alexander-1309’s couple. Their identity cannot be assumed, and the 1771 child has no inspected occupation, wife or estate bridge identifying him as the merchant rather than the Colinton account John-1304. The merchant’s circa 1770 birth is an inherited estimate, not independent corroboration. Retain both modern Johns and the current father selection, all mothers, vital fields and upstream grades. No new father attachment or merge follows. The 1741 childhood identification of Alexander-1309 is not certified by this review. Exact percentages are subjective judgements, not measured probabilities.
